summary: T07 create-from-Apple implementation meets all acceptance criteria. Conditional PUT creates events through EventService, events are readable in both systems, duplicates/partial writes fail safely, and audit behavior is preserved. No concrete defects found.
important_context: Non-transactional create+mapping is a design choice; rollback is best-effort via event_service.delete. Plan transactional requirement applies to T09/T10.
Race condition on concurrent PUTs maps to 500 instead of 412/409, but UNIQUE constraints prevent data corruption.
